high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in a well-lit, modern interior space. The individual is wearing a black, form-fitting outfit consisting of a short-sleeved top and wide-leg pants. They are also wearing white sneakers with gray accents. The person is holding a smartphone to take the photo, covering their face. The setting appears to be a dining area or a living room with a large arched mirror reflecting part of the room. The room has a clean, minimalist design with white walls and wooden flooring. There is a wooden dining table with chairs visible on the right side of the image.
